title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode3 Less Stars More Bass

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The observatory?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's all go next Saturday!
You normally don't get to go inside, you know!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I heard about it too!
It's usually closed to the public.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're doing an open lecture about stars, so I was thinking about going myself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I expect no less from you, Honami, our resident star expert!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're exaggerating...
Besides, that place is quite famous.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's very interesting. A place where you can see the stars and learn about them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can imagine that knowing more about stars makes gazing at them even more enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't need to go to an observatory to see the stars. They even look prettier here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's a true... But I thought it'd be nice if we could all go together for a change.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We could also go to a cafe, check out clothing stores, a karaoke place...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that the main reason you want to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Those are just some other fun things we could do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona...!
Shiho's being mean to me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, there. No need to get upset.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you not interested in going to the observatory, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not that. I just think it's not worth the trip is all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That time would be better spent on more band practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're so down to earth, Shiho.
Or down to play bass, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that supposed to be funny?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sometimes the things you come out with are kind of bizarre, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bizarre...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, don't add fuel to the fire!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you just want to hang out, we can do that close to our station. There's no need to—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to be in sync with each other if you're going to make good music as a team.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to connect through things other than music every now and then. It can only help you as a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho... You really don't want to go?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Give me a moment to think it over.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have work on that day, so I'll have to swap my shift with someone else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So you'll come?
Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Stop being so clingy.
I get enough of that from my sister...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sounds like you've persuaded her, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I only gave Shiho a little nudge in the direction she was already leaning towards.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's just one condition. Don't start slacking off with band practice because of this trip.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I see you start to get lazy, I'm out. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No worries! I'll practice diligently every day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Every day? But you also have soft tennis club and your part-time job... Won't that be too much?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll be fine!
I'm not how I used to be!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You say that now, but you caught a bad cold that kept you in bed for a whole week after pushing yourself too hard that one time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can manage!
Stop worrying so much, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nothing's going to stop me from enjoying my wonderful teenage life♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's have a wonderful time, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, not really.
It's nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That only makes me more curious. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's just that... Saki seemed a little different today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The tone of her voice told me that she was straining herself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Her voice sounded strained...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That means... I don't want that to happen again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka.
I'll make sure to look after Saki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, let's get started with band practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright. Saki, it's good to be enthusiastic, but don't push yourself past your limits, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not a little kid or anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can play our songs perfectly now, you know!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? Okay, let's make a bet. If you make a mistake, you've got to buy me ramen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It shouldn't be a problem if you're so confident, right? And if you play everything without slipping up, I'll treat you to bubble tea. Toppings and all, so it's a level price.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Your treat?
I'm going to win this bet for sure!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Are you okay, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you think about it, it makes no sense! Why on earth does ramen cost the same as bubble tea?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you think of the cost of the ingredients, it just doesn't add up... Right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You started shouting all of a sudden and we thought...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh? I-I'm sorry!
It just hit me and...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
You made us all jump!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry!
L-Let's start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Let's start from just before the chorus. Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They seem to be having fun...
Are you still worried, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A little.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe I'm overthinking it...
